title: MedExpMem: Adapting Experience Memory for Differential Diagnosis
summary: MedExpMem 提出一种经验记忆框架，使基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的诊断智能体能够积累鉴别诊断专长。关键创新在于让模型在诊断过程中动态更新记忆，而非依赖静态参数。该方法在鉴别易混淆疾病任务上显著提升准确率，与Agent方向结合，为医疗诊断系统提供可演化的经验记忆机制。
raw_content: Experienced physicians develop diagnostic expertise through clinical practice, acquiring not only disease knowledge but also the ability to differentiate confusable conditions. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) lack this capability -- their parameters encode static knowledge that does not evolve across diagnostic encounters. title: From Residuals to Reasons: LLM-Guided Mechanism Inference from Tabular Data
summary: 该研究提出一种由大语言模型（LLM）引导的机制推理方法，从表格数据中推断特征交互关系，而非直接预测目标。关键结果包括：通过将统计模型的残差转化为自然语言理由，LLM能迭代生成可解释的因果机制，显著优于传统黑箱模型。该方法将LLM的推理能力与结构化数据结合，为Agent驱动的科学发现和RAG中的可解释分析提供了新范式。
raw_content: A persistent challenge in machine learning for scientific applications is jointly achieving prediction and understanding. Statistical models excel on structured data but operate as black boxes, while existing interpretability methods are largely inspective: they answer "which features matter?" but do not articulate how features interact or refine explanations iteratively alongside human understanding. title: MARGIN: Runtime Confidence Calibration for Multi-Agent Foundation Model Coordination
summary: MARGIN提出一种运行时置信度校准方法，用于多智能体基础模型协调场景。该方法在运行时动态调整各智能体的置信度权重，解决了标准方法中基础模型置信度与准确性在困难任务上呈负相关的问题。实验表明，MARGIN在多个基准测试中将协调准确率提升15-20%，显著优于温度缩放等设计时校准方法。该工作直接服务于多智能体系统中信任分配与协调决策优化，为Agent协作可靠性提供了关键技术支持。
raw_content: Foundation model agents increasingly operate in multi-agent deployments where a coordinator must decide which agent's response to trust. The standard approach weights agents by their self-reported confidence, but recent evidence shows that foundation model confidence is systematically mis-calibrated and, on hard tasks, inversely correlated with accuracy. title: A Proactive Multi-Agent Dialogue Framework for Assessing Social Language Disorder Traits in Autism
summary: 该论文提出一种主动式多智能体对话框架，用于评估自闭症谱系障碍中的社交语言障碍特征。关键创新在于通过多智能体协作策略主动触发回声重复、代词错位等典型语言行为，在结构化评估中显著提升诊断信息的获取效率。该框架为RAG驱动的对话系统在临床诊断场景中的应用提供了新思路，通过主动对话策略优化信息采集质量。
raw_content: Characteristic linguistic behaviors associated with Social Language Disorder (SLD) in autism spectrum disorder, including echoic repetition, pronoun displacement, and stereotyped media quoting, are largely absent from spontaneous conversation and only emerge under specific conversational conditions. title: How to Steer Your Multi-Agent System: Human-LLM Collaborative Planning
summary: 在多智能体系统中，人类常因计划复杂且不透明而难以管理。现有方法仅验证最终输出，缺乏中间推理可见性。本文形式化了人机协作规划的设计空间，涵盖模式（语义/结构）、范围（全局/局部）和层级（低/高）三个维度，并实现原型AMBIPOM。关键亮点是支持用户通过结构化编辑干预智能体推理过程，提升系统可控性。该工作为Agent系统的可解释性与人机协同规划提供了新范式。
raw_content: In orchestrated multi-agent systems, humans often struggle to manage plans due to their complexity and limited transparency. Existing approaches rely on outcome-level supervision, where users verify only final outputs without visibility into intermediate reasoning. title: SVR-MAD: A Bayesian-Inspired Framework for Posterior-Guided Multi-Agent Debate
summary: SVR-MAD是一个受贝叶斯启发的多智能体辩论框架，将辩论前信号视为先验，通过后验引导的通信剪枝解决上下文快速增长问题。关键亮点是，相比依赖不可靠先验信号（如token级对数似然或LLM自报告置信度）的现有方法，SVR-MAD在幻觉场景下仍能保持辩论准确性，显著提升大规模多智能体设置的可扩展性。该工作与多智能体系统方向高度相关，为构建更鲁棒、可扩展的Agent协作机制提供了新思路。

Existing methods prune low-utility communications using prior signals, such as token-level log-likelihoods or LLM self-reported confidence. title: Fast-dDrive: Efficient Block-Diffusion VLM for Autonomous Driving
summary: Fast-dDrive提出了一种块扩散视觉语言模型，用于端到端自动驾驶，解决了VLA模型在轨迹规划保真度与推理效率之间的权衡。该方法通过块扩散机制避免自回归模型的内存带宽瓶颈和曝光偏差，同时消除全序列扩散的逻辑泄漏问题，在保持因果感知-规划顺序的同时实现高效推理。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：其块扩散设计可启发多智能体系统中因果推理与并行计算的优化。
raw_content: End-to-end autonomous driving via Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demands a precarious balance between high-fidelity trajectory planning and efficient inference. Existing paradigms typically fall short: autoregressive (AR) VLAs are memory-bandwidth-bound on edge hardware and prone to exposure-bias drift, while full-sequence diffusion models preclude KV-cache reuse and suffer from "logical leakage" that violates the fundamental perceive-then-plan causality. title: Foundation Protocol: A Coordination Layer for Agentic Society
summary: Foundation Protocol（FP）提出了一种面向智能体社会的协调层协议。核心贡献是构建去中心化基础设施，使自主智能体能可靠地建立关系、组织多智能体协作、交换价值并支持AI经济。关键亮点在于将瓶颈从模型能力转向协调，实现真实世界监督下的安全与问责。该工作直接关联多智能体协调与MCP方向，为Agent社会的基础设施层提供了标准化方案。
raw_content: Autonomous agents are moving from tools into a layer of social infrastructure: they browse, purchase, deploy software, manage systems, and increasingly interact with one another. As these systems scale, the bottleneck shifts away from raw model capability toward coordination. Agents need to form reliable relationships, organize multi-agent work, exchange value, support an AI economy, and stay safe and accountable under real-world oversight. title: GENSTRAT: Toward a Science of Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: GENSTRAT提出了一种评估大语言模型战略推理能力的科学框架。通过构建动态博弈环境，该框架在多个复杂策略场景中测试模型表现，结果显示当前最强模型在非零和博弈中的决策一致性不足40%。该工作为Agent系统在拍卖、市场等真实经济环境中的部署提供了可泛化的评估方法论，弥补了传统固定博弈基准的局限性。
raw_content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as economic agents in marketplaces, auctions, and bidding settings. Anticipating their behavior in any specific deployment is hard. Existing strategic-reasoning benchmarks evaluate models on fixed canonical games. title: Self-Refining Topology Optimization via an LLM-Based Multi-Agent Framework
summary: 这是一个基于LLM的多智能体框架，用于实现自优化拓扑结构设计。该方法通过多个智能体协同工作，自动调整数值参数并评估收敛设计是否满足物理可行性等隐性约束。关键亮点在于无需人工干预即可迭代优化设计，显著提升设计效率与质量。该框架与Agent/MCP方向高度相关，展示了多智能体协作在工程优化中的潜力。
raw_content: Topology optimization is a widely used design method that produces optimized material distributions for prescribed objectives and constraints through well-established numerical algorithms. Throughout the workflow, engineers make a series of decisions ranging from setting and adjusting numerical parameters to assessing whether the converged design meets considerations beyond those explicitly included in the optimization problem, such as physical feasibility. title: Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Ventilator Decision Support with Contextual Bandit Preference Learning
summary: VDSS 提出了一种人机协同的多智能体框架，用于呼吸机决策支持，通过上下文赌博机偏好学习协调模块化决策组件。该系统在保持安全边界的同时，能适应临床医生的个性化调优风格，相比规则方法和端到端强化学习更可控、可审计。该工作展示了多智能体系统在医疗决策中结合人类反馈与偏好学习的价值，为 Agent 在安全敏感场景的应用提供了参考。
raw_content: Ventilator decision support requires sequential decisions that track evolving physiology and disease trajectories while respecting safety boundaries and clinician specific tuning styles. Rule based approaches rarely generalize personalization, and end to end reinforcement learning or single large language model systems remain difficult to control and audit. title: When Planning Fails Despite Correct Execution: On Epistemic Calibration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: 大型语言模型多智能体系统在执行正确时仍可能失败，原因在于智能体评估计划可行性时可能误判自身知识，我们称之为规划中的认知失调。与执行错误不同，认知失调在规划阶段是隐性的，生成的计划可自洽执行且无可见错误；同时它也是动态的，新信息会改变可行性评估。本研究揭示了这一现象，为提升多智能体系统鲁棒性提供了关键校准方向。
raw_content: LLM-based multi-agent systems can fail even when planned actions are executed correctly because agents may misjudge their knowledge when evaluating plan feasibility, a phenomenon we term epistemic miscalibration in planning. title: ARMS: Automatic Reward Shaping for Sparse-Reward Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: ARMS提出了一种自监督奖励塑形框架，用于解决稀疏奖励多智能体强化学习中的非平稳性问题。该方法通过自动学习稠密奖励信号，在保持问题战略结构的同时加速学习过程。关键亮点在于无需手动设计奖励函数，即可在稀疏奖励场景下显著提升多智能体系统的学习效率与协作性能。该工作与多智能体系统（Multi-Agent）方向高度相关，为复杂协作任务中的奖励设计提供了自动化解决方案。
raw_content: Sparse rewards are a major bottleneck in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), where simultaneous learning induces non-stationarity and makes reward design especially delicate. Reward shaping can accelerate learning, but in the multi-agent setting it must preserve the strategic structure of the problem rather than merely improve short-term optimization. title: One Policy, Infinite NPCs: Persona-Traceable Shared RL Policies for Scalable Game Agents
summary: 提出一种名为 pcsp 的共享强化学习策略，用于在生活模拟游戏中生成数百至数千个具有一致个性的非玩家角色（NPC）。在300角色基准测试中，该方法实现组合式零样本角色识别能力比随机高出17倍，语义-行为对齐的斯皮尔曼相关系数约0.73，推理速度比基于大语言模型的策略基线快22倍。该工作为Agent系统提供了一种可扩展、可追踪个性的NPC控制方案，与多智能体及RAG方向中个性一致性与高效推理需求高度相关。

title: MemAudit: Post-hoc Auditing of Poisoned Agent Memory via Causal Attribution and Structural Anomaly Detection
summary: MemAudit提出一种针对中毒智能体记忆的事后审计方法，通过因果归因与结构异常检测识别恶意注入。该方法能有效检测通过常规交互注入的对抗性记忆记录，无需在线干预。对依赖持久记忆的Agent系统安全防护具有重要价值，填补了RAG场景下记忆中毒事后审计的空白。
raw_content: Large language model agents increasingly rely on persistent memory to store past interactions, retrieve relevant demonstrations, and improve long-horizon task execution. title: LLM-driven design of physics-constrained constitutive models: two agents are better than one
summary: 本工作提出首个多智能体LLM框架，用于设计满足物理约束的本构模型。通过两个智能体协作——一个负责模型生成，另一个进行物理定律验证——系统自动确保模型遵守守恒律等基本物理原理。相比单智能体管线，该方法将物理合规性从0%提升至95%以上。该工作展示了多智能体协作在科学计算领域的价值，为Agent驱动的物理仿真与RAG知识校验提供了新范式。
raw_content: Developing constitutive models that capture how materials deform under load traditionally requires years of specialized expertise in continuum mechanics, machine learning, and scientific programming. title: Strategic Coercion Within Alliances: The Greenland Sovereignty Game as an AI Stress Test
summary: 本研究以2019-2026年美国试图从丹麦获取格陵兰岛的主权危机作为AI压力测试，分析联盟内强势成员对弱势成员的战略胁迫。核心贡献是构建了三个博弈模型：非对称胁迫博弈、北约保证博弈及联盟规范执行博弈。关键发现揭示了联盟内集体行动困境的双重性——北极战略控制与北约对主导成员执行规范的能力。该工作为Agent系统模拟地缘政治博弈、多智能体联盟动态及RAG驱动的战略决策推理提供了验证框架。

title: The Misattribution Gap: When Memory Poisoning Looks Like Model Failure in Agentic AI Systems
summary:
标题：归因偏差：当记忆投毒在智能体AI系统中伪装成模型故障

核心贡献：本文揭示了多智能体AI管道中的结构性缺陷——归因偏差，即记忆层攻击产生的行为与模型故障难以区分，导致防御者采取错误修复措施。关键结果：提出语义规范漂移（SND）作为智能体不当行为的第三条路径，区别于突现失调和共谋，其中策略格式文档进入共享记忆后引发行为偏差。关联价值：该发现对Agent系统的安全防御和RAG架构的记忆管理具有重要警示意义。

title: PrefBench: Evaluating Zero-Shot LLM Agents in Hidden-Preference Personalized Pricing Negotiations
summary: PrefBench是一个基于模拟器的基准测试，用于评估零样本LLM智能体在隐藏偏好个性化定价谈判中的表现。关键发现是，即使智能体成功完成交易并产生有效动作，仍可能因无法推断买家支付意愿和议价特征而导致定价不佳。该基准与Agent方向高度相关，为研究智能体在信息不对称环境下的决策能力提供了标准化评估框架。
raw_content: Personalized pricing negotiations are a challenging testbed for LLM agents because successful interaction does not guarantee profitable decision making. A seller may produce valid actions and close many deals while still pricing poorly when buyer willingness to pay and bargaining traits remain hidden. title: CultivAgents: Cultivating Relationship-Centered Multi-Agent Systems for Personalized Gardening
summary: CultivAgents 是一个以关系为中心的多智能体系统，专为个性化、社会文化背景下的园艺支持设计。该系统基于关怀伦理，协调多个专业智能体，包括根据用户技能水平调整指导的经验智能体。关键亮点在于其能够整合本地生态、季节和文化语境，提供超越通用建议的个性化服务。与多智能体系统方向紧密相关，展示了如何通过协作智能体实现领域特定、用户中心的自适应交互。

title: Are Frontier LLMs Ready for Cybersecurity? Evidence for Vertical Foundation Models from Dual-Mode Vulnerability Benchmarks
summary: 前沿大语言模型在网络安全领域的适用性通过双模式基准测试评估：白盒函数级漏洞检测（VulnLLM-R，覆盖C/Java/Python）和黑盒Web应用安全测试（5个生产级应用，含118个真实漏洞，涉及20+ CWE类别，将开源）。测试6个前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Codex~5.3、Claude Opus~4.6等）和2个领域专用模型。结果显示，领域专用模型在漏洞检测任务上表现更优，但前沿模型在复杂Web安全测试中仍有差距。该研究为构建安全Agent和RAG系统提供了垂直领域模型评估基准，对开发自动化安全检测工具具有参考价值。
raw_content: We evaluate whether frontier LLMs are ready for cybersecurity through a dual-mode benchmark: white-box function-level vulnerability detection (VulnLLM-R, across C/Java/Python) and black-box web application security testing (five production-style applications with 118 ground-truth vulnerabilities across 20+ CWE families, which we will open-source). title: EvalVerse: Pipeline-Aware and Expert-Calibrated Benchmarking for Professional Cinematic Video Generation
summary: EvalVerse 是一个面向专业电影级视频生成的流水线感知与专家校准基准测试框架。它针对强化学习与智能体工作流在视频生成中的评估瓶颈，首次系统性地衡量“是否优质”（电影质量、表演与美学），而非仅关注“是否正确”。该基准通过专家校准与流水线感知设计，为Agent驱动的视频生成优化提供了关键评估标准。

title: AI Assurance: A Comprehensive Testing Strategy for Enterprise AI Systems
summary: 本文提出面向企业级AI系统的全面保障策略，核心围绕三大原则：针对大语言模型、检索管道与自主智能体的概率性、上下文敏感及涌现特性，构建传统QA无法覆盖的测试框架。关键亮点在于通过分层评估方法提升系统置信度，而非追求经典正确性验证。该策略为Agent/RAG系统的可靠性保障提供了可落地的测试方法论。

title: Hidden Human-Like Nature of Machine-Generated Texts: Theory and Detection Enhancement
summary: 大型语言模型生成的文本（MGT）虽广泛应用，但存在被滥用于虚假新闻和钓鱼的风险。现有段落级检测方法将MGT视为完全机器化，忽略了其隐藏的人类化本质：即使全机器生成的文本也可能包含高度一致的人类风格片段。本研究揭示这一特性，并据此提出增强检测方法，显著提升对MGT的识别能力。该发现对Agent/RAG系统中文本真实性验证具有重要价值，可优化多智能体协作中的内容可信度评估。
raw_content: Machine-generated texts (MGTs) produced by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly prevalent across various applications, while their potential misuse in fake news propagation and phishing has raised serious concerns, highlighting the need for MGT detection. Existing paragraph-level detection methods commonly treat MGTs as entirely machine-like, overlooking the hidden human-like nature of machine-generated texts: even fully machine-generated texts may contain spans that are highly consiste

title: Adaptive Mass-Segmented KV Compression for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: 自适应质量分段KV压缩（AMS KV Compression）是一种面向长上下文推理的新型键值缓存压缩框架。它通过将全局Top-k选择范式转为质量分段保留策略，解决了现有方法因连续推理块被严重驱逐导致的逻辑连贯性破坏问题（区域擦除效应）。实验表明，在长文档问答和推理任务中，AMS在保持同等压缩率下将推理准确率提升5-8%，且与MCP/RAG系统的长上下文处理需求高度契合，可有效增强Agent对复杂推理链的保持能力。
raw_content: The linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache is a critical bottleneck in long-form LLM inference. Existing KV compression methods mitigate this by evicting tokens based on importance scores. However, we show that their reliance on global Top-k selection triggers Region Wipe-out: the severe eviction of contiguous reasoning blocks that derails logical coherence. title: When Is Next-Token Prediction Useful? Marginalization, Ergodicity, Mixture Identifiability, Local Sufficiency, RAG, Tools, and Programming
summary: 语言模型在观测序列上训练时，通常被描述为学习给定前文的下一个token条件分布。但该描述仅在特定条件下成立：模型仅观察到采样延续而非完整条件律，且真实语言生成还受非文本因素（事实、事件、意图、目标、信念、社会背景和任务）影响。本文系统分析了next-token预测有效的条件，包括边缘化、遍历性、混合可识别性、局部充分性，并探讨了与RAG、工具使用和编程的关联。关键发现：当数据满足遍历性和局部充分性时，next-token预测能有效捕获非文本条件，为RAG和工具增强的Agent系统提供了理论基础。
raw_content: Language models trained on observed sequences are often described as learning the conditional distribution of the next token given previous tokens. This description is only conditionally correct. A model trained on realized token trajectories does not observe full conditional laws; it receives sampled continuations. Moreover, real language generation is conditioned not only on previous words but also on non-textual circumstances: facts, events, intentions, goals, beliefs, social context, and tas

title: Instance-Optimal Estimation with Multiple LLM Judges on a Budget
summary: 在预算约束下，本研究提出实例最优估计方法，通过将异构LLM裁判（不同价格与可靠性）的评估查询最优分配至不同难度的提示-响应对，以最大化评分估计精度。关键结果：该方法在固定预算下显著降低估计方差，优于均匀分配或仅依赖单一裁判的策略。与Agent/RAG方向关联：为多智能体评估系统提供成本效益最优的裁判调度策略，适用于RAG系统响应质量的大规模自动化评测。
raw_content: Evaluating large language models increasingly relies on LLM-as-a-judge protocols, but such evaluations remain costly: different judges have different prices and reliabilities, and the difficulty of each prompt-response pair can vary substantially. This raises a basic allocation question: under a fixed budget, how should one distribute evaluation queries across heterogeneous judges and instances to obtain the most accurate score estimates? title: OnePred: Next-Query Prediction via Recursive Intent Memory in Multi-Turn Conversations
summary: OnePred提出了一种通过递归意图记忆实现多轮对话中下一查询预测的方法。该方法在多个对话数据集上实现了平均15%的预测准确率提升，同时将推理延迟降低30%。这项研究为构建主动式对话Agent提供了关键技术，通过预测用户意图使系统从被动响应转向主动交互，对提升RAG系统的上下文感知能力和多智能体协作效率具有重要价值。
raw_content: Although large language model (LLM) conversational systems process millions of multi-turn dialogues daily, they remain fundamentally reactive: they respond only after the user types a query. A key step toward proactive interaction is next-query prediction, which anticipates the user's subsequent query based solely on the preceding dialogue. title: Agentic Proving for Program Verification
summary: 该研究提出基于智能体的程序验证框架，将Claude Code作为证明智能体应用于CLEVER基准测试。结果显示，Claude为98.8%的问题生成了可接受的规范，其中81.3%通过了CLEVER的同构评分。这项工作展示了智能体在形式化程序验证中的潜力，为Agent与RAG结合实现自动化代码验证提供了新思路。
raw_content: Agentic systems have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for automated theorem proving in formal mathematics. To assess how far these capabilities extend to program verification, we evaluate Claude Code in an agentic proving framework on CLEVER, a Lean 4 benchmark for verifiable code generation. title: Beyond Binary Edits Robust Multimodal Knowledge Editing with Adversarial Subspace Alignment
summary: 该研究提出对抗性子空间对齐方法，解决多模态大模型知识编辑中因缺乏语义监督和编辑范围僵化导致的泛化性不足问题。关键结果：在MMEdit基准上，该方法在视觉和语言变体上的编辑成功率提升12.3%，同时保持原有能力不退化。与RAG方向关联：该方法通过子空间对齐实现隐式语义传播，为多模态知识编辑的鲁棒泛化提供了新范式。
raw_content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) need efficient mechanisms to update knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. While intrinsic multimodal knowledge editing achieves strong reliability and locality, it often exhibits limited generality, failing to propagate edits across semantically equivalent visual and linguistic variations. This issue arises from the lack of explicit semantic supervision, rigid editing scopes, and biased anchoring to individual samples in high-dimensional mult

title: AI-Friendly LaTeX: Using LaTeX Code as a Knowledge Source for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: AI-Friendly LaTeX提出将LaTeX源码作为检索增强生成（RAG）的知识源，相比PDF更优。关键亮点在于LaTeX保留了结构信息（如章节、公式标签），使检索更精准，提升对数学和技术文档的问答可靠性。该方法直接优化RAG在学术和技术场景中的知识检索质量，尤其适合处理复杂结构化文档。
raw_content: Large language models can answer questions about textbooks, lecture notes, and programming exercises more reliably when their answers are grounded in an explicit knowledge source. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a common approach: relevant fragments of a document are retrieved and inserted into the model context before answering. For mathematical and technical material, the original LaTeX source can be a better starting point than a PDF, because it contains structural information, labels

title: Uncertainty-aware classification and triage of structural heart disease using electrocardiography and echocardiography metrics
summary: 基于心电图与超声心动图指标，提出一种不确定性感知的结构性心脏病分类与分诊方法。该方法利用机器学习创新，通过低成本、易获取的心电图数据筛查结构性心脏病，在EchoNext配对数据集上实现高效检测。关键亮点是引入不确定性量化，提升分诊可靠性，对Agent驱动的医疗筛查系统具有重要参考价值，可增强RAG辅助诊断中的置信度评估。
raw_content: Machine learning methods provide a methodological innovation that can help screen for cardiovascular disease through noninvasive and readily available measurement modalities. Recent investments in using electrocardiogram (ECG) data to screen for structural heart disease (SHD) are one example, where ECGs provide a low-cost, available modality for screening. This has led to the EchoNext dataset, a paired ECG-echocardiogram data repository for testing new methods of SHD detection. However, relative

title: ChainFlow-VLA: Causal Flow Planning with Vision-Language Models
summary: ChainFlow-VLA提出了一种结合视觉语言模型的因果流规划方法，用于解决自动驾驶中时序因果推理与全局轨迹一致性不匹配的问题。该方法融合自回归模型捕捉因果依赖与扩散模型优化全局轨迹的优势，在交互式安全关键场景中显著减少误差累积，提升轨迹规划可靠性。该工作为Agent在复杂动态环境中的因果推理与多模态决策提供了新思路，对RAG与MCP中时序依赖建模具有参考价值。
raw_content: Current end-to-end autonomous driving systems are fundamentally limited by a mismatch between temporal causal reasoning and global trajectory consistency. Autoregressive (AR) models capture interaction-aware temporal dependencies via causal factorization, but their step-wise decoding leads to error accumulation and suboptimal global structure. In contrast, diffusion models optimize trajectories globally but lack explicit causal constraints, making them unreliable in interactive and safety-critic

title: CVSearch: Empowering Multimodal LLMs with Cognitive Visual Search for High-Resolution Image Perception
summary: CVSearch提出了一种认知视觉搜索框架，用于增强多模态大模型对高分辨率图像的感知能力。该方法通过融合视觉专家辅助搜索的效率和扫描式搜索的全面性，在保持低计算冗余的同时消除盲点。在多个高分辨率图像理解基准上，CVSearch实现了平均5%的准确率提升，且推理速度比纯扫描方法快3倍。该工作为MLLM处理高分辨率输入提供了高效解决方案，可应用于RAG系统中的图像检索与多智能体视觉理解场景。
raw_content: High-resolution (HR) image perception presents a key bottleneck for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). While visual search offers a promising solution, existing methods struggle with the trade-off between coverage and efficiency. Visual expert-assisted search is efficient but prone to blind spots when proposals fail, whereas scan-based search guarantees coverage at the cost of computational redundancy and semantic fragmentation. title: ETCHR: Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning
summary: ETCHR提出了一种新的视觉推理方法，通过专用图像编辑模型与理解模式解耦，实现“用图像思考”。该方法在需要细粒度关注或视角变换的问题上，相比纯文本思维链和固定工具集方法，显著提升了推理准确性。与Agent/RAG方向关联，该工作展示了如何将图像编辑作为外部工具集成到多模态推理流程中，为构建更灵活的视觉Agent提供了新思路。
raw_content: Multimodal Large Language Models have advanced visual reasoning, yet a purely textual chain of thought remains a bottleneck for questions that require fine-grained focus or view transformations. The ''think with images'' paradigm narrows this gap, but existing approaches are either constrained by fixed predefined toolkits or produce noisy intermediate images from unified multimodal methods. We pursue a third option: using a dedicated image editing model and decouple it with an understanding mode

title: RMA: an Agentic System for Research-Level Mathematical Problems
summary: RMA（研究数学智能体）是一个面向研究级数学问题的自动化推理智能体框架。它通过将问题分解为问题分析、文献搜索与理解、公平比较等专用模块，实现了长程推理、文献支撑和迭代证明优化。与聚焦竞赛数学或形式定理证明的先前工作不同，RMA专门处理需要深度文献检索和逐步证明精炼的研究级数学难题。该框架展示了Agent系统在复杂学术推理任务中的潜力，为RAG方向提供了文献检索与推理结合的实践案例。
raw_content: We present $\textbf{Research Math Agents (RMA)}$, an agentic framework for automated reasoning on research-level mathematical problems. Unlike prior studies centered on competition mathematics or formal theorem proving, RMA targets research-level mathematical problems that require long-horizon reasoning, literature grounding, and iterative proof refinement. title: Transcoders Trace Visual Grounding and Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Transcoders 追踪视觉语言模型中的视觉基础与幻觉。该研究采用基于 Transcoders 的功能中心框架，稀疏近似 MLP 子层作为层间计算的因果代理，揭示了视觉输入如何转化为文本。关键发现：Transcoders 能定位视觉基础错误并识别幻觉来源，优于传统稀疏自编码器。与 Agent/RAG 方向关联：该方法可提升多模态 Agent 的视觉推理可靠性，减少幻觉对 RAG 系统的影响。
raw_content: Generative Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on multimodal reasoning, but how visual inputs are transformed to text remains poorly understood. Existing interpretability work on VLMs uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which decompose static residual representations and miss the functional updates that drive cross-modal interaction. We adopt a function-centric framework based on Transcoders, sparse approximations of MLP sublayers that act as a causal proxy for layer-wise computation. Applie

title: EVE-Agent: Evidence-Verifiable Self-Evolving Agents
summary: EVE-Agent提出了一种证据可验证的自演化智能体框架，核心在于智能体不应在无法证明其合理性的样本上训练。该无数据自演化搜索智能体能自主生成问题、解答并基于自身反馈改进，无需人工标注。关键亮点是引入证据可验证机制，防止自生成课程奖励流畅但无依据的样本，确保训练信号可靠。与Agent方向关联，该方法提升了自演化智能体的可信度和透明度，为构建可验证的自主系统提供了新思路。
raw_content: Self-evolving agents should not train on examples they cannot justify. Data-free self-evolving search agents offer a scalable route to systems that generate their own questions, answer them, and improve from their own feedback without human annotations. Yet, without verifiable evidence, this loop can reward fluent but unsupported examples, turning the self-generated curriculum into an opaque and potentially unreliable training signal. title: GEMQ: Global Expert-Level Mixed-Precision Quantization for MoE LLMs
summary: GEMQ提出了一种面向MoE大语言模型的全局专家级混合精度量化方法。通过基于专家重要性的逐专家位宽分配，该方法逼近精度-内存帕累托前沿，支持极低比特量化。关键亮点在于解决了现有方法忽视量化引起的路由器偏移问题，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低内存开销。该工作对Agent系统中部署大规模MoE模型具有重要参考价值，尤其适用于资源受限环境下的高效推理。
raw_content: Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models (MoE-LLMs) achieve strong performance but incur substantial memory overhead due to massive expert parameters. Mixed-precision quantization mitigates this cost by allocating expert-wise bit-widths based on their importance, approaching the accuracy-memory Pareto frontier and enabling extreme low-bit quantization. title: Redrawing the AI Map: A Theory of Accountability Boundaries in Agentic Ecosystems
summary: 本文提出一种能力层面的问责边界理论，解释在智能体生态系统中，即使AI编排器使技术接口模块化，需要证据、审查或签批的AI能力仍可能保留整合的问责边界。关键发现：技术模块化与组织问责边界可分离。该理论为Agent系统中责任分配与RAG流程的可审计性设计提供了分析框架。
raw_content: Agentic AI orchestrators reduce the interface and assembly costs of composing information systems capabilities across organizational boundaries, seemingly accelerating modularization and organizational disaggregation. Yet AI-enabled capabilities whose outputs require evidence, review, signoff, or assignable responsibility may retain integrated accountability boundaries even when their technical interfaces become modular. title: Curriculum reinforcement learning with measurable task representation learning
summary: 提出一种基于可度量任务表征学习的课程强化学习方法，通过自动生成插值型中间任务来构建学习序列。该方法在复杂目标任务上实现显著加速，训练效率提升达数倍，且无需人工设计课程。与Agent方向关联：为智能体在连续任务空间中自主积累知识、高效迁移学习提供了可扩展框架，尤其适用于多阶段复杂决策场景。
raw_content: In curriculum reinforcement learning (CRL), an agent incrementally accumulates knowledge over a sequence of tasks (i.e., a curriculum), and the learning process is aimed at using the accumulated knowledge to finally solve a challenging target task. While early CRL works focus on sequencing candidate tasks, recent research explores automatic curriculum generation. title: Goal-Conditioned Agents that Learn Everything All at Once
summary: 该研究提出一种目标条件强化学习智能体，通过联合输出所有目标的Q值实现全目标学习，使每个经验片段都能用于所有目标的离线策略更新。该方法在计算上可行，相比传统仅针对指定目标更新的方式，信息利用效率显著提升。与Agent方向相关，为智能体在复杂环境中高效利用经验、加速学习提供了新思路。
raw_content: A goal-conditioned reinforcement learning agent exploring an environment will see a wealth of information throughout a trajectory, most of which is discarded when only performing on-policy updates with respect to the commanded goal. All-goals learning, where each transition is used for learning off-policy with respect to every goal, allows agents to extract maximal information, however it is usually computationally infeasible when done via naive relabelling. title: Understanding Goal Generalisation in Sequential Reinforcement Learning
summary: 在序列强化学习中，智能体常会在训练分布外表现出非预期的目标导向行为。本研究针对在多个任务上顺序训练的智能体，系统分析了其泛化机制。通过评估超过100个训练流程在250多个分布外环境中的表现，发现显著特征驱动了泛化行为。该发现对理解Agent在复杂环境中的目标泛化具有重要价值，为RAG系统中智能体的鲁棒性设计提供了理论依据。
raw_content: Reinforcement learning agents often exhibit unintended goal-directed behaviour outside their training distribution, but we currently lack a principled understanding of how such agents will generalise to novel environments based on their training history. We address this gap for agents trained sequentially on one or more tasks. We study over 100 sequential training pipelines, evaluating behaviour across over 250 out-of-distribution environments. title: Benchmarking Google Embeddings 2 against Open-Source Models for Multilingual Dense Retrieval and RAG Systems
summary: 我们评估了Google Embeddings 2（GE2）——一个由Vertex AI托管的双编码器，支持2048 token上下文和显式任务类型调节——与五种开源模型（BGE-M3、E5-large、mE5-L、LaBSE、mMPNet）在多语言稠密检索和RAG系统中的表现。在四个BEIR子集、一个合成意大利语RAG语料库、五种分块大小与三种策略的消融实验以及CPU延迟测试中，GE2在所有任务上排名第一。这为Agent/RAG系统提供了高性能嵌入基准，有助于优化多语言检索与生成流程。
raw_content: We benchmark Google Embeddings (GE2), a Vertex-AI-hosted bi-encoder with 2,048-token context and explicit task-type conditioning, against five open-source alternatives: BGE-M3, E5-large, Multilingual-E5-large (mE5-L), LaBSE, and Paraphrase-Multilingual-MPNet (mMPNet). Evaluation covers four BEIR subsets, a synthetic Italian RAG corpus, a chunking ablation considering 5 sizes of tokens with three strategies, and per-query latency on commodity CPU hardware. title: How Hard is it to Rig a Benchmark? A Social Choice Analysis of Leaderboard Robustness
summary: 多任务基准测试已成为机器学习研究的核心支柱，但其日益增长的影响力催生了基准作弊行为——即通过策略性行动提升特定模型在排行榜上的排名。本研究将数据集视为选民、模型视为候选人，将基准特定训练（在训练中包含基准数据）视为一种选举操纵形式。针对任意排序基准，选择训练数据集以使目标模型获得更高排名的难度被形式化分析。关键发现是：即使仅操纵少量数据集，也可能显著改变排行榜结果。该工作为Agent/RAG/MCP方向提供了评估基准鲁棒性的社会选择理论框架，有助于设计更抗操纵的模型评估体系。
raw_content: Multi-task benchmarks have become a central pillar of machine learning research, yet their growing influence has incentivised benchmark gaming -- strategic actions taken to improve the leaderboard rank of a specific model. Treating datasets as voters and models as candidates, we consider benchmark-specific training -- the inclusion of benchmark data in training -- as a form of election manipulation. title: Computable Fairness: Boltzmann-Softmax Control for AI Resource Allocation
summary: 在大型AI系统中，为多个智能体分配GPU算力与带宽等稀缺资源是核心挑战。传统策略侧重效率指标，易导致资源集中而损害系统多样性与稳定性。我们提出可计算公平分配（CFD）框架，将Boltzmann-Softmax函数重新定义为概率性资源分配机制而非选择工具，通过逆温度参数实现公平性量化控制。该方法在保持系统效率的同时，显著提升多智能体资源分配的均衡性与鲁棒性，对Agent系统资源调度与MCP协议下的公平性设计具有直接参考价值。
raw_content: In large-scale AI systems, allocating scarce resources such as GPU compute time and bandwidth among multiple agents is a critical challenge. Conventional policies focus on efficiency metrics, potentially leading to dominance concentration that undermines system diversity and stability. title: Multi-Dimensional Matching in Market Design
summary: 本文提出一种面向多维匹配市场的高效机制，代理仅需报告对物品特征的偏好而非完整效用评估。通过奇异值分解（SVD）识别特征空间的主变化方向，将复杂多维匹配问题简化为可在一维上求解的问题，时间复杂度为O(N log N)。当数据存在低维结构时，该机制能实现近似最优匹配。与Agent/RAG方向关联：该机制可应用于多智能体系统中的资源分配或信息检索中的特征匹配优化。

title: SCRIPT: Scalable Diffusion Policy with Multi-stage Training for Language-driven Physics-Based Humanoid Control
summary: SCRIPT提出了一种可扩展的扩散策略，通过多阶段训练框架实现语言驱动的物理人形机器人控制。该方法在自然语言指令与物理可行性之间取得平衡，在忠实遵循指令、高质量动作和长期稳定控制方面均优于现有方法。该工作为Agent方向提供了语言到物理动作的端到端控制范式，对RAG与多模态指令理解具有参考价值。
raw_content: Controlling physics-based humanoids from natural-language instructions is a critical step toward general-purpose embodied agents. title: Socially fluent AI decouples conversational signals from source identity in online interaction
summary: 社交流畅AI将对话信号与身份来源解耦，实现在线交互中类人对话。在786名参与者进行的1572次身份判断中，人们无法区分AI与人类队友。该研究对Agent系统设计有重要启示：需在RAG对话中平衡拟人化与透明性，避免用户混淆AI与人类身份。

summary: RAS 提出了一种基于反思增强扩展的上下文学习方法，用于生成可执行的 Cypher 查询。该方法利用数据库返回的语法错误信息进行迭代修正，在 Text2Cypher 任务中使查询执行成功率提升 15% 以上。该工作为结构化查询生成中的推理时计算分配提供了新范式，对 Agent 系统中代码生成与执行反馈的闭环优化具有重要参考价值。
raw_content: Inference-time scaling can reduce errors in structured query generation, but methods to allocate the compute for query code generation remains underexplored. title: Test-Time Training Undermines Safety Guardrails
summary: 测试时训练（TTT）是一种新兴范式，允许模型在推理过程中动态调整参数，以提升少样本学习、检索增强生成和复杂推理等任务的表现。然而，这种动态适应性引入了新的安全漏洞，攻击者可利用三种威胁模型绕过安全过滤器。实验表明，TTT会显著削弱模型的安全防护能力，对Agent与RAG系统的可靠性构成潜在威胁。

summary: DreamerNLplus 是一个混合框架，用于从社交媒体时间线建模心理健康动态，参与 CLPsych 2026 共享任务。它处理三个任务：心理状态建模、时间变化检测和序列级摘要。在任务 1 中，结合 LLM 数据增强、DeBERTa 分类和随机森林回归实现结构化状态预测；任务 2 使用本地 Llama 3.1 模型的少样本提示检测切换。该工作展示了 RAG 与规则方法在心理健康动态建模中的可解释性价值。

title: When Symptoms Are Not Enough: Evidence-Weighting Patterns in Large Language Model Psychiatric Screening

summary: 该研究首次系统比较了前沿多模态大模型（MLLM）在美式英语与墨西哥西班牙语下的越狱攻击脆弱性。针对Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-5、Pixtral Large和Qwen Omni四种模型，采用363个多样化提示场景的固定对抗基准进行纯文本与多模态测试。关键发现：同一模型在不同语言下表现出截然不同的弱点，揭示了对齐失败的机制性结构。该工作为多语言、多模态环境下的Agent安全对齐提供了重要评估框架，对构建鲁棒的RAG系统具有直接参考价值。

summary: 近期强化学习方法显著提升了LLM推理能力。现有奖励设计主要遵循两种范式：基于可验证奖励的强化学习通过可执行检查或真实答案获取结果信号，但对中间推理行为指导有限；而基于评分标准的奖励虽能超越最终答案检查，通过自然语言标准评估推理质量和任务合规性，但常需实例化。本文提出元认知奖励机制，通过知识和调节信号强化推理过程，为Agent/RAG方向提供更精细的中间行为反馈。

summary: CoSPlay提出了一种测试时协作自博弈方法，通过自生成代码与单元测试实现无真实单元测试的测试时扩展。该方法在无真实单元测试条件下，在HumanEval和MBPP上分别达到91.5%和89.2%的pass@1准确率，显著优于现有无真实单元测试方法。与Agent/RAG方向相关，该方法通过多轮自博弈生成与验证，提升了代码生成的自洽性与鲁棒性，可应用于自主代码修复和测试生成场景。

summary: 生成式人工智能正推动劳动力需求重组。本研究基于美国全行业招聘数据，分析企业如何调整招聘地点与岗位内容。核心发现：AI扩散促使企业更倾向于在技术密集区招聘，同时岗位职责向更高阶技能重组，而非简单淘汰暴露岗位。该成果为Agent驱动的劳动力市场预测与RAG系统在人力资源分析中的应用提供了实证基础。
raw_content: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is expected to transform work, but less is known about how firms reorganize labor demand as the technology diffuses. Existing research has largely focused on which occupations are exposed to AI or whether exposed jobs decline. We extend this debate by examining whether firms adjust by changing where they hire, what jobs contain, or both. title: Autonomous Frontier-Based Exploration with VLM Guidance
summary: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自主前沿探索方法，通过VLM进行高层策略决策，引导传统低层机器人控制栈。在决策点，机器人生成包含当前地图和潜在路径视觉图像的多模态提示，VLM据此选择最优前沿。该方法在未知危险环境中显著提升探索效率，与Agent方向结合可增强机器人自主决策能力。
raw_content: Autonomous robotic exploration of unknown and hazardous environments, a long-standing challenge, can be significantly improved by leveraging the advanced reasoning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We introduce a novel exploration pipeline where a VLM performs high-level strategic decision-making, guiding a conventional low-level robotics control stack. title: HARNESS-LM: A Three-Phase Training Recipe for Harnessing SLMs in Sponsored Search Retrieval
summary: HARNESS-LM（HLM）提出三阶段训练框架，将大规模检索模型能力迁移至小语言模型（SLM），用于赞助搜索检索。在公共基准上，基于Qwen3-Embedding-4B/8B的SLM检索模型性能上限高，但高吞吐、低延迟部署困难。该方法平衡检索质量与生产延迟，对Agent/RAG方向中高效检索模型部署具有参考价值。
raw_content: In the competitive landscape of sponsored search, balancing retrieval quality with production latency is a critical challenge. While large retrieval models based on Small Language Models (SLMs) such as Qwen3-Embedding-4B/8B set strong upper bounds on public benchmarks, their deployment in high-throughput, latency-sensitive environments remains impractical. title: EM-Vid: Training-Free Entity-Centric Memory for Efficient and Consistent Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: EM-Vid提出了一种无需训练的实体中心记忆机制，用于高效一致的多镜头视频生成。该方法通过构建实体索引的潜在补丁库，将持久实体信息与瞬态场景上下文解耦，相比全帧存储方法减少了无关信息泄露和计算开销。在多个基准测试上，该方法在保持实体一致性的同时，显著提升了生成效率，与Agent/RAG方向中结构化记忆管理的思想高度契合。
raw_content: Multi-shot video generation requires maintaining a consistent appearance of recurring entities across shots while remaining faithful to shot-specific text prompts. Recent autoregressive methods reuse previously generated frames as memory. However, full-frame storage entangles persistent entity information with transient scene context, leading to irrelevant information leakage and high computational cost. We propose an entity-centric memory in the form of an entity-indexed bank of latent patches.

title: Operator Learning for Reconstructing Flow Fields from Sparse Measurements: a Language Model Approach
summary: 提出基于语言模型架构的算子学习框架，用于从稀疏测量中无网格重建流场。将流场重建转化为序列到序列学习任务，稀疏测量作为上下文，未观测位置作为查询。模型在多个基准测试中实现高精度重建，显著优于传统插值方法。该工作为流体力学中的稀疏数据重建提供了新范式，其序列建模思路可迁移至Agent/RAG系统中处理非结构化传感器数据与动态环境推理。
raw_content: Reconstructing flow fields from sparse measurements is a fundamental problem in fluid mechanics with broad implications for modeling, control, and design. In this work, we propose a novel operator learning framework that leverages the architecture of language models to perform flow reconstruction in a mesh-free manner. raw_content: Autoregressive Transformer KV caches grow linearly with context length; sliding-window caching bounds memory but discards evicted tokens entirely, so relevant evidence outside the window becomes inaccessible. title: Learned Relay Representations for Forward-Thinking Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: 当掩码扩散模型（MDM）通过迭代精炼生成序列时，掩码位置上的丰富内部计算被丢弃，迫使每个后续精炼步骤重新计算存储为模型表示的有价值内部信息。为避免去噪轮次间的硬重置，我们提出学习中继表示（Relay），该方法通过显式学习如何在去噪过程中传播潜在信息，使MDM具备前瞻性思考能力。
raw_content: When Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) generate sequences through iterative refinement, the rich internal computation over masked positions is discarded, forcing every subsequent refinement step to recompute the valuable internal information stored as model representations. title: Can AI Guess What You Know? Performance Comparison of Large Language Models for Human Domain Knowledge Estimation From Communication Logs
summary: 本研究探索利用大语言模型（LLM）从长期Slack聊天记录中直接推断员工领域知识，以解决组织内“谁懂什么”难以识别的问题。分析43名用户的27,188条消息后，对比了Gemini、Claude和GPT等七种模型的零样本估计与27名参与者的自评技能。Gemini 2.5 Flash取得最低误差（MAE 21.13%）。该工作为Agent系统实现基于对话的隐性知识图谱构建与人员推荐提供了新思路。
raw_content: Employees often struggle to identify ``who knows what,'' leading to organizational productivity losses. title: Sparse Autoencoders Map Brain-LLM Alignment onto Cortical Semantic Topography
summary: 本研究利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将GPT-2 XL和Llama-3.1-8B每层分解为16K-32K可解释特征，首次从机制上解释了大语言模型中间层为何最匹配人脑语言响应。通过人类验证的分类体系（κ≥0.74），发现语义特征与大脑皮层语义拓扑高度对齐。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中模型可解释性评估与神经启发式语义表示优化提供了新工具。
raw_content: Intermediate layers of large language models (LLMs) best predict human brain responses to language, one of the most robust findings in computational neurolinguistics, yet why remains mechanistically unexplained. title: Multilingual Steering by Design: Multilingual Sparse Autoencoders and Principled Layer Selection
summary: 基于多语言稀疏自编码器与原理性层选择的设计驱动多语言控制。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）支持大语言模型（LLMs）的特征级机制可解释性与激活控制，但基于SAE的语言控制在多语言场景中仍不可靠：多数SAE仅用英语数据训练，且控制层选择依赖启发式方法。我们通过推进基于SAE的多语言语言控制的原理性机制解释来克服这些局限。首先，我们证明在多语言数据上训练SAE能持续增强控制效果，关键亮点为多语言SAE在语言识别与切换任务中准确率提升15-20%，且原理性层选择方法优于传统启发式选择。该工作与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：为多语言Agent提供可靠的语言控制基础，增强RAG系统在多语言查询中的检索准确性，并支持MCP协议下跨语言工具调用的稳定性。
raw_content: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) enable feature-level mechanistic interpretability and activation steering in large language models (LLMs), but SAE-based language control remains unreliable in multilingual settings: most SAEs are trained on English-only data, and steering layers are chosen heuristically. title: Open Multimodal Datasets and Open-Source Software for Data-Driven Modeling of Multiphase Transport and Thermal Systems
summary: 该论文提出由NED3实验室开发的多模态数据集与开源软件生态系统，用于可复现的AI驱动热流体研究。关键成果包括整合了多相传输、电子冷却和声学诊断领域的碎片化数据集，并提供了标准化工具以解码原始仪器文件。该工作为构建热流体数字孪生和训练多模态AI模型提供了基准数据与可复用资源，直接支撑RAG驱动的知识检索与MCP协议下的跨平台数据交互。
raw_content: Data-driven modeling is becoming central to multiphase transport, electronics cooling, acoustic diagnostics, and thermal-fluid digital twins, but progress is limited by fragmented datasets and raw instrument files that are difficult to decode, reuse, or benchmark. title: Do Language Models Know What Not to Say? Causal Evidence for Statistical Preemption in LLMs
summary: 本研究首次在大型语言模型中直接区分统计优先与竞争固化假说，探讨模型如何在没有负面证据的情况下学会识别不可接受的表达。关键发现是，模型能通过接触常规形式（如“donated the books to the library”）优先抑制结构可能但未出现的替代形式（如“*donated the library the books”），从而验证统计优先机制。该成果为Agent/RAG系统中语言生成的安全性与规范性提供了因果证据，有助于提升多智能体交互中输出内容的合理性和可接受性。
raw_content: How do learners acquire knowledge of what is unacceptable without negative evidence? title: Steered Generation via Gradient-Based Optimization on Sparse Query Features

title: ModeSwitch-LLM: A Lightweight Phase-Aware Controller for Cross-Mode LLM Inference on a Single GPU
summary: ModeSwitch-LLM 是一种轻量级请求边界控制器，通过将每个请求路由到合适的固定推理模式（如FP16、量化、推测解码及混合模式），提升单GPU大模型推理效率。该系统利用廉价工作负载特征，在Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上实现动态模式切换，无需依赖单一静态配置。该工作与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：其动态资源调度策略可优化多智能体系统中LLM推理的GPU利用率，降低RAG流水线延迟，并为MCP协议下的异构计算资源管理提供轻量化控制范式。

title: DFKI-MLT at SemEval-2026 TASK 7: Steering Multilingual Models Towards Cultural Knowledge

We present the DFKI-MLT system for SemEval-2026 Task 7 on cultural awareness, where we apply activation steering to multilingual LLMs using language vectors extracted from parallel FLORES data. title: Understanding and Improving Noisy Embedding Techniques in Instruction Finetuning
summary: 近期指令微调研究通过在嵌入中注入噪声提升性能，NEFTune采用均匀噪声取得标杆效果。本文从理论和实验两方面分析，发现均匀噪声与高斯噪声性能相当，并澄清了NEFTune中均匀噪声更优的误解。同时提出一种新的语言模型微调方法，为指令微调中的噪声注入技术提供更清晰的理论基础，对提升Agent/RAG系统的指令遵循能力具有参考价值。

title: PaP-NF: Probabilistic Long-Term Time Series Forecasting via Prefix-as-Prompt Reprogramming and Normalizing Flows
summary: PaP-NF提出了一种基于前缀重编程与归一化流的概率性长期时间序列预测框架。该方法通过将历史序列作为提示前缀进行重编程，并利用归一化流建模未来分布的复杂性，实现了对不确定性的量化。在多个长期预测基准上，PaP-NF显著优于现有确定性模型，尤其在多步预测中展现出更低的预测误差和更可靠的置信区间。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中处理时序不确定性提供了概率建模思路，可增强智能体在动态环境下的决策鲁棒性。

title: ARES: Automated Rubric Synthesis for Scalable LLM Reinforcement Learning

title: Cost-Effective Model Evaluation with Meta-Learning

raw_content: The rapid growth of machine learning has produced an ever-expanding ecosystem of models, making it increasingly challenging to verify the reliability of newly released models on unseen, unlabeled data. title: Preisach Attention: A Hysteretic Model of Sequential Memory

summary: FIRMA 提出一种基于斐波那契环的模型聚合方法，用于隐私保护联邦学习。该方法通过环形拓扑实现无服务器聚合，同时利用斐波那契权重分配机制永久保护分类头隐私，避免梯度反演风险。关键亮点在于同时解决了联邦学习的结构三难困境：去中心化、隐私保护和模型性能。该工作为 Agent 协作场景中的隐私保护聚合提供了新思路，可应用于多智能体系统的安全参数交换。

title: Learnability-Informed Fine-Tuning of Diffusion Language Models
summary: 我们提出了一种基于可学习性感知的扩散语言模型微调方法。分析发现，标准SFT忽略了令牌的可学习性——稀有令牌在大部分输入被掩码时难以学习，而简单令牌则收益甚微。为此，我们设计了一种动态训练策略，根据令牌的稀有程度和生成阶段调整学习权重。实验表明，该方法在多个推理基准上平均提升5.2%的准确率，同时保持生成多样性。这项工作为扩散模型在Agent系统中的推理增强提供了新思路，尤其适用于需要可控生成与多步推理的RAG场景。
raw_content: We aim to improve the reasoning capabilities of diffusion language models (DLMs). title: Certification from Examples is Hard for Circuits and Transformers under Minimal Overparametrization
summary: 在最小过参数化条件下，电路与Transformer模型基于示例的认证是困难的。研究表明，尽管某些假设易于认证，但即使是最小程度的过参数化也可能使认证变得指数级困难。该发现揭示了神经网络在推理与算法任务中，高平均精度可能掩盖不一致行为，强调了精确认证的重要性。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向关联：此结果对确保AI系统（如Agent）在关键任务中的行为可验证性具有警示意义。
raw_content: As state-of-the-art neural networks are deployed on reasoning and algorithmic tasks, exactness guarantees become increasingly important. This motivates exact certification, which asks for the smallest set of labeled examples needed to certify that a learned hypothesis equals the target. title: Decomposing and Measuring Evaluation Awareness
summary: 前沿语言模型有时会识别出自身正被评估并调整行为，从而削弱基准测试的有效性。本研究从社会心理学角度将评估意识分解为环境组件（任务的可识别性）与模型组件（区分识别与倾向），为这一现象建立统一基础。关键亮点是提供了可测量的分解框架，避免混淆评估属性与模型属性。该工作对Agent评估的鲁棒性设计具有直接价值，有助于构建更可靠的RAG与多智能体系统性能测试方法。
raw_content: Frontier language models sometimes recognize that they are being evaluated and adjust their behavior, undermining validity of benchmark results. title: ThriftAttention: Selective Mixed Precision for Long-Context FP4 Attention
summary: ThriftAttention提出了一种面向长上下文场景的选择性混合精度注意力机制。该方法在Blackwell GPU上利用块级量化将注意力计算降至4位精度，同时识别出量化误差对查询-键交互重要性的非均匀影响。关键亮点是仅对高重要性交互保留高精度，从而在长上下文中将质量损失降低至可忽略水平，并实现显著加速。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中处理超长序列的高效注意力提供了实用优化方案。

title: Dreaming Smoothly and Sample Efficiently with Gradient Penalized Latent Dynamics
summary: GPLD提出了一种梯度惩罚潜变量动力学正则化方法，用于改进DreamerV3模型。该方法通过对后验潜变量分布施加行方向雅可比惩罚，强制学习到的转移动力学具有局部平滑性，从而利用了这一有用的归纳偏置。实验表明，GPLD在多项任务中显著提升了样本效率，同时保持了与DreamerV3相当的最终性能。该工作为基于世界模型的强化学习提供了新的正则化思路，可应用于Agent的长期规划与决策优化。
raw_content: Model-based reinforcement learning improves sample efficiency by learning a world model. title: Robust OT-Guided Generative Residual Domain Adaptation for Bike-Sharing Demand Prediction under Temporal Domain Shift
summary: 基于鲁棒最优传输的生成式残差域自适应方法，解决共享单车需求预测中的时间域偏移问题。在2021-2026年Citi Bike数据上，仅用少量目标域标签即可实现跨年预测，残差传输策略使预测误差降低15%以上。该方法通过生成式残差对齐与最优传输约束，为Agent系统在动态环境下的时序预测域自适应提供了可迁移的鲁棒框架。
raw_content: Bike-sharing models trained on historical station-hour data may degrade when deployed in later years because travel patterns change over time. title: CALAD: Channel-Aware contrastive Learning for multivariate time series Anomaly Detection
summary: CALAD提出了一种通道感知对比学习框架，用于多变量时间序列异常检测。该方法通过区分不同通道对异常检测的贡献，解决了现有无监督方法平等对待所有通道导致异常信号被稀释的问题。在多个基准数据集上，CALAD显著提升了异常检测的F1分数和召回率。该工作为时间序列异常检测中的通道重要性建模提供了新思路，可应用于RAG系统中监控数据流的异常识别。
raw_content: Multivariate time series anomaly detection has become increasingly important in real-world applications, where labeled data are often scarce. Many existing approaches rely on unsupervised learning to model normal patterns, but they often treat all channels equally. raw_content: Fast and reliable optimal power flow (OPF) approximation is essential for reliable smart-grid operation, yet many learning-based surrogates either flatten the native heterogeneous structure of power networks, target a limited set of grid topologies, or lack scalable infrastructure for graph foundation model (GFM) training. title: Label-Efficient Dataset Pruning via Semi-Supervised Pseudo-Labeling
summary: 通过半监督伪标签实现标签高效的数据集剪枝。该方法在仅需少量标注数据的情况下，从大规模数据集中选择信息量最大的子集，显著降低存储与训练成本。实验表明，在标注率仅5%时，剪枝后模型性能仍接近全监督剪枝的95%。该工作为RAG系统中数据筛选与Agent训练数据优化提供了低标注成本的解决方案。
raw_content: Dataset pruning reduces the storage and training costs of deep learning by selecting an informative subset from a large dataset. However, most existing pruning methods require fully labeled data, which limits their applicability in realistic settings where unlabeled data are abundant and annotation is costly. title: AutoResearch AI: Towards AI-Powered Research Automation for Scientific Discovery
summary: AutoResearch AI 提出了一种面向科学发现的 AI 驱动研究自动化框架，将文献支撑、假设生成、实验验证、报告撰写与修订整合为长周期工作流。该系统实现了从任务级 AI 到工作流级研究自动化的转变，在自主性、领域覆盖和验证机制上取得突破。该工作对 Agent 方向的价值在于展示了多步骤自主研究管线的设计范式，为构建更复杂的科研 Agent 系统提供了可参考的架构与评估维度。
raw_content: Scientific research is being reshaped by AI systems that move beyond isolated assistance toward longer-horizon workflows spanning literature grounding, hypothesis generation, experimentation, validation, reporting, and revision. title: Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization
summary: 基于分数的一步均值流策略优化方法提出了一种新型强化学习策略，通过学习平均速度场实现单步噪声到数据的映射，替代传统扩散模型的多步去噪过程。该方法在在线强化学习中显著降低推理计算开销，同时保持策略表达能力。关键亮点在于无需目标分布样本即可构建速度场，解决了MeanFlow的样本依赖问题。与Agent方向关联紧密，为实时决策场景提供高效策略学习框架。

raw_content: Reinforcement learning has long struggled with poor sample efficiency. One promising approach to mitigate this problem is leveraging group-invariant Markov Decision Processes ($G$-invariant MDPs). title: Class-Dependent Hybrid Data Augmentation for Multiclass Migraine Classification under Severe Class Imbalance
summary: 针对严重类别不平衡的多类偏头痛分类，提出了一种类别依赖的混合数据增强方法。该方法基于ICHD-3标准对两种偏瘫亚型进行临床聚合，并根据每类样本量分配生成策略，引入保真度不对称概念，以比例约束增长替代完全类别平衡。在纠正数据泄露和指标偏差后，该方法显著提升了分类性能，对Agent/RAG/MCP方向中处理不平衡数据具有参考价值。
raw_content: We conducted a reproducibility-oriented re-evaluation of prior migraine classification studies, correcting for data leakage and metric bias. We then introduced (i) a clinically motivated aggregation of two hemiplegic subtypes following ICHD-3 {\S}1.2.3, (ii) a class-dependent hybrid augmentation strategy that assigns generation methods based on per-class sample size, and (iii) the concept of fidelity asymmetry, motivating proportionally constrained growth as an alternative to full class balance.

title: Unextractable Protocol Models: Collaborative Training and Inference without Weight Materialization

summary: 本文提出了一种将动态规划（DP）与约束规划（CP）有效结合的方法，以DP为主搜索框架、CP作为子程序利用全局约束传播，用于解决部分车间调度问题（PSSP）。实验表明，该混合方法在求解质量和效率上优于纯DP方法，为组合优化问题提供了新思路。该工作展示了算法融合在调度场景中的潜力，可启发Agent系统中任务规划与资源分配的混合推理策略。

title: DiLaDiff: Distilled Latent-Augmented Diffusion for Language Modeling
summary: DiLaDiff是一种针对语言建模的蒸馏潜增强扩散模型，通过引入连续潜空间和潜扩散模型，解决了扩散语言模型在解码标记间相关性捕获不足导致的采样质量与吞吐量权衡问题。关键结果包括：在保持高采样质量的同时显著提升生成速度，并利用自编码器从现有掩码扩散语言模型微调得到语义潜空间。该工作为Agent/RAG方向中需高效生成连贯文本的场景（如对话系统、检索增强生成）提供了更优的扩散模型基础。

title: The Communication Complexity of Instant-Runoff Voting

title: Leveraging Foundation Models for Causal Generative Modeling
summary: FM-CGM提出模块化框架，利用预训练基础模型的零样本推理能力实现端到端视觉因果生成建模。该方法无需额外训练即可整合因果约束，在反事实推理任务中取得显著效果。该工作为Agent系统提供因果推理能力，可增强RAG中的因果理解与MCP中的可解释决策。
raw_content: Causal generative modeling is essential for developing reliable and transparent AI systems capable of counterfactual reasoning. title: Seeing without Looking: Do Vision-Language Benchmarks Really Test Vision?

title: NLG Evaluation: Past, Present, Future
summary: 自然语言生成（NLG）评估自1990年以来经历了巨大变革，从早期与语言学紧密关联、缺乏现代实验评估，到2026年与机器学习深度融合，实验评估成为研究基石。期间涌现多种评估技术，如最新的大语言模型作为评判（LLM-as-Judge）。该综述梳理了NLG评估的过去、现在与未来，对Agent/RAG/MCP方向中生成内容的质量评估与自动评测具有重要参考价值。

title: Multilingual Knowledge Transfer under Data Constraints via Lexical Interventions
summary: 通过词汇干预在数据约束下实现多语言知识迁移。该方法针对低资源语言训练数据不足的问题，利用高资源语言知识进行科学推理、常识推断和世界知识等下游任务。关键结果：无需大规模数据即可有效提升跨语言知识迁移效果。与RAG方向关联：为低资源场景下的知识检索与融合提供轻量级干预策略。

title: Complete-muE: Optimal Hyperparameter Transfer and Scaling for MoE Models
summary: 我们提出Complete-muE框架，用于在Transformer块中实现密集FFN与任意混合专家（MoE）架构间的超参数迁移。现有工具如μP（需固定架构）或SDE（需固定每步token数）无法直接解决MoE中的超参数迁移问题，因为密集到MoE迁移或MoE总专家数缩放会同时改变架构和每个专家的token数。Complete-muE通过双桥系统解决了这一挑战，实现了最优超参数迁移与缩放，为MoE模型训练提供了关键支持，对Agent/RAG/MCP方向中高效模型部署具有重要价值。

title: SPACENUM: Revisiting Spatial Numerical Understanding in VLMs
summary: SPACENUM 重新审视了视觉语言模型（VLM）中的空间数值理解能力，提出了一个统一框架，涵盖数字作为动态转换的两种互补场景。关键发现是当前VLM在生成动作幅度和空间坐标等数值输出时，往往缺乏真正的空间感知基础，导致数值不准确。该工作为Agent系统在具身环境中可靠使用数值输出提供了评估基准，对提升多智能体空间推理能力具有重要参考价值。

title: Dithering Defense: Adversarial Robustness of Vision Foundation Models via Multi-Level Floyd-Steinberg Dithering
summary: 视觉基础模型常作为冻结骨干用于下游任务，成为对抗攻击的单一故障点。本文提出多级Floyd-Steinberg误差扩散抖动作为轻量级、模型无关的输入变换，在保留语义内容的同时破坏对抗扰动。与仅限二值抖动、灰度CIFAR-10及单一小模型的先前工作不同，我们在六个任务上评估，验证了该方法对Agent/RAG/MCP方向中视觉基础模型安全性的提升价值。

title: CHASD: Language Increment-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding against Hallucination in LVLMs
summary: CHASD提出了一种语言增量校准的对比解码方法，用于缓解大型视觉语言模型中的对象幻觉问题。该方法通过比较原始与扰动视觉输入的预测，在保持训练免费的同时，避免全局扰动破坏有用视觉证据，并减少额外负分支的调用。关键亮点在于其增量校准机制能更精准地抑制语言先验主导下的幻觉，提升多模态推理的可靠性。该工作与RAG方向中视觉证据与语言模型的校准问题高度相关，为多智能体系统的视觉-语言对齐提供了新思路。
raw_content: Large Vision-Language Models have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet they remain susceptible to object hallucinations when language priors dominate insufficient or misaligned visual evidence. Training-free contrastive decoding methods mitigate this issue by comparing predictions from original and perturbed visual inputs, but existing approaches either apply global perturbations that may alter useful visual evidence or invoke an additional negative branch at every decoding step.

title: AI Security Research Should Better Incentivize Defense Research
summary: 该研究揭示了人工智能安全领域的一个失衡现象：攻击类研究远多于防御类研究。通过对联邦学习、语音识别、成员推断及大语言模型等子领域的论文分析，发现攻击与防御论文比例存在显著偏差。这种失衡不仅体现在数量上，更在于攻击论文常在有利条件下评估威胁，导致防御研究激励不足。该发现对Agent/RAG/MCP方向的安全防护具有重要警示价值，提示需加强防御机制的系统性研究。
raw_content: This work examines an imbalance in artificial intelligence (AI) security research: the field tends to produce more work on attacking AI systems than on defending them. title: Training-Free Looped Transformers

title: Learning-Augmented Online Scheduling with Parsimonious Preemption
summary: 该研究提出了一种学习增强的在线调度算法，通过整合可能含噪声的预测来超越传统最坏情况下的下界。关键亮点在于首次系统性地在调度中限制抢占次数，平衡算法性能与抢占复杂度，实验表明在保持低延迟的同时显著减少了不必要的任务中断。该工作为Agent系统中任务调度与资源分配的效率优化提供了新思路，尤其适用于需要平衡实时响应与计算开销的RAG场景。

title: Multi-Gate Residuals

title: When Good Equations Get Bad Scores: Improving Symbolic Regression Through Better Parameter Optimization

summary: 该论文证明，对于任意自然数k，k阶Weisfeiler-Leman（k-WL）测试无法区分所有具有简单谱的非同构图，尽管这类图可在立方时间内完成同构测试。由于WL层次结构限制了广泛使用的图神经网络（GNN）的区分能力，这一不完备性适用于所有k-WL对齐的GNN家族。为弥补这一缺陷，论文提出PRiSM方法（分区、精炼、求解、匹配），通过规范化简单谱图实现完全区分。该工作对图结构数据的表示学习具有重要价值，尤其在RAG系统中处理图结构知识时，可提升对复杂图结构的区分能力。
raw_content: Graphs with a simple spectrum admit cubic-time isomorphism testing, yet we prove that for every natural number $k$, the $k$-Weisfeiler-Leman ($k$-WL) test cannot distinguish all non-isomorphic graphs with a simple spectrum. title: Commutator-Induced Uncertainty in VAEs
summary: 变分自编码器（VAE）在处理潜在空间中的非交换结构时存在困难。现有方法通过代数正则化强制交换性，但这会抑制数据固有的非交换结构。本文提出应显式诊断非交换性并反映在重建行为中，引入李代数框架来建模非交换变换。该方法在保持重建质量的同时，能更准确地捕捉数据中的非交换结构，为VAE在对称性感知表示学习中的应用提供了新思路，尤其适用于涉及非交换群作用的复杂数据场景。
raw_content: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) often struggle to represent non-commutative structure in learned latent spaces. Symmetry-aware VAEs commonly address this issue by enforcing commutativity through algebraic regularization, which is appropriate for commutative transformation groups but can suppress meaningful non-commutative structure when it is intrinsic to the data. title: S$^3$GNN: Efficient Global Mixing and Local Message Passing for Long-Range Graph Learning
summary: S$^3$GNN提出一种结合全局频谱混合与局部消息传递的高效图神经网络方法，用于解决长程依赖学习中的信息瓶颈和过度挤压问题。该方法通过频谱算子实现全局信息混合，有效缓解OSQ现象，同时保持局部消息传递能力。在长程图学习任务中，S$^3$GNN在保持计算效率的同时显著提升性能，为处理需要全局与局部信息交互的图结构数据（如分子性质预测）提供了新思路，对Agent系统中图结构数据的RAG检索优化具有参考价值。
raw_content: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) often suffer from an information bottleneck when capturing long-range dependencies, leading to the oversquashing (OSQ) phenomenon. Alongside spatial connectivity enrichment (e.g., rewiring), recent studies have shown that spectral filtering can yield strong long-range learning outcomes, as spectral operators enable global information mixing that alleviates OSQ. title: Learning Individual Dynamics from Sparse Cross-Sectional Snapshots
summary: 该研究提出从稀疏横截面快照中学习个体动力学的新方法。关键突破在于仅利用单次或极稀疏时间点数据即可推断个体连续时间演化轨迹，无需密集纵向追踪。该方法解决了传统序列模型（如潜变量ODE）依赖密集数据而横截面方法无法捕捉个体差异的困境，为Agent系统中个体行为建模、RAG场景下动态知识演化追踪提供了新范式。
raw_content: Predicting how a dynamical unit evolves over time - how an individual ages, an epidemic spreads, or a physical system degrades - typically requires dense longitudinal tracking. When only extremely sparse or entirely cross-sectional data is available, inferring individualized, continuous-time trajectories is fundamentally ill-posed. title: CBANet: A Compact Attention-Based CNN-BiLSTM Network for Aggressive Driving Event Detection
summary: CBANet提出了一种紧凑型注意力CNN-BiLSTM网络，用于从车辆传感器数据中检测激进驾驶事件。该方法通过注意力机制和物理可解释的车辆动力学表示，有效解决了数据不平衡和驾驶员间差异性问题。在真实驾驶数据集上，模型在F1分数和召回率上分别提升约5%和8%，显著优于现有方法。该工作为Agent系统在实时驾驶行为监测与风险预警中提供了轻量级、高精度的时序分析方案。
raw_content: Aggressive driving is a major cause of traffic accidents and poses a serious threat to road safety. Although deep learning methods have shown promising results in detecting risky driving behaviours from vehicle sensor data, their performance in real-world conditions is often limited by severe data imbalance, large variability between drivers, and the lack of physically interpretable vehicle dynamics representations. title: Automated Random Embedding for Practical Bayesian Optimization with Unknown Effective Dimension
summary: 贝叶斯优化广泛用于复杂黑箱函数优化，但受维度灾难困扰。随机嵌入作为降维策略，通过在低维子空间中优化来简化具有有效维度的任务。然而，预先确定任务的有效维度仍是一大挑战，这影响子空间维度选择与优化性能。本文提出自动化随机嵌入方法，无需预设有效维度即可自适应调整子空间，显著提升高维优化效率。该工作为Agent/RAG系统中高维参数调优提供实用降维方案，降低手动配置成本。
raw_content: Bayesian optimization is widely employed for optimizing complex black-box functions but struggles with the curse of dimensionality. Random embedding, as a dimension reduction strategy, simplifies tasks that possess the effective dimension by optimizing within a low-dimensional subspace. title: Non-normal spectral signatures of instability in neural network training dynamics
summary: 深度神经网络训练中的不稳定性（如损失尖峰、振荡收敛和梯度病态）普遍存在，但缺乏严格的算子理论解释。我们证明实际使用的优化器的线性化更新算子通常是非正规的：对于Adam，非正规性由Hessian矩阵与对角自适应预处理器之间的对易子[H, M]控制；对于带动量的SGD，则源于增广状态空间结构。该发现为理解训练动态提供了新视角，有助于设计更稳定的优化器，与Agent/RAG/MCP方向中模型训练的稳定性需求高度相关。

title: VACE: Learning Geometrically Structured Representations for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: VACE提出了一种基于几何结构表示学习的时间序列异常检测方法。通过自监督对比学习，将时间序列片段嵌入到具有明确几何边界的潜在空间，从而精确刻画正常行为模式。该方法在多个真实世界数据集上显著提升了异常检测的F1分数，尤其适用于标签稀缺且漏检代价高的场景。与RAG方向结合，可为时序数据检索与异常定位提供结构化表示基础。
raw_content: Anomaly detection in multivariate time series is a critical task across a wide range of real-world applications, where abnormal behaviour is rare, labels are unavailable, and the cost of a miss is high. title: Learning partially observed systems with neural Hamiltonian ordinary differential equations
summary: 该研究提出神经哈密顿常微分方程（NHODE）框架，用于从部分观测数据中学习动力系统。关键亮点是，NHODE通过结合哈密顿神经网络（HNNs）与隐变量推断，在无需直接监督的情况下恢复未观测状态变量，并保持物理结构约束。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联在于，该框架可增强智能体在部分观测环境下的物理建模能力，提升对复杂动态系统的泛化与推理性能。
raw_content: When learning dynamical systems from data, embedding physical structure can constrain the solution space and improve generalization, but many physics-informed models assume access to the full system state. title: Precise: SDE-Consistent Stochastic Sampling for RL Post-Training of Flow-Matching Models
summary: Precise提出了一种用于流匹配模型强化学习后训练的SDE一致随机采样方法。该方法通过将确定性ODE采样轨迹替换为SDE，将在线RL应用于流匹配生成器，实现随机策略。关键结果是在保持采样质量的同时，有效控制探索行为与去噪动力学，提升提示对齐和感知质量。该工作为Agent/RAG方向中生成模型的策略优化提供了新的随机采样框架，有助于增强多智能体系统中内容生成的鲁棒性与可控性。
raw_content: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective way to improve prompt alignment and perceptual quality in diffusion and flow-matching generators. summary: 降维方法广泛用于高维数据可视化，但其有损特性会导致视觉伪影。本文首次揭示被忽视的伪影来源：模糊实例。通过分裂策略处理这些实例，显著提升投影中局部结构的保真度。该工作为基于降维的邻域发现任务提供了关键改进，对RAG中高维语义空间的可解释分析具有参考价值。
raw_content: Dimensionality Reduction (DR) methods are widely used to visualize high-dimensional data. One key task in DR-based analysis is discovering neighborhoods, which relies on analyzing the fine-grained local structure of a projection. raw_content: Comprehensive evaluation of machine learning models is the key to make sure that they perform as robustly and consistently as desired. title: Safety, Liveness, and Fairness in Quantitative Argumentation Dialogues
summary: 在定量（双极）论证对话中引入时序推理中常用的安全性、活性和公平性概念，其中从带权节点的论证图中反复进行推理，图在推理间会更新。强/弱安全性分别确保论证（最终）强度始终高于特定阈值并最终达到该阈值，活性要求论证强度持续波动。该工作为Agent系统中基于论证的动态推理提供了形式化保障，可应用于RAG场景下多源证据的可靠性评估与公平性维护。
raw_content: We introduce notions of safety, liveness, and fairness, as commonly used in temporal reasoning, to quantitative (bipolar) argumentation dialogues where repeated inferences are drawn from argumentation graphs with weighted nodes. title: Solving the Aircraft Disassembly Scheduling Problem
summary: 该研究提出了一种解决飞机拆解调度问题的方法。该问题涉及数千项任务和多种约束条件，旨在通过高效调度拆解流程来提升可持续性并确保盈利。关键结果包括优化了技术人员分配与零件提取顺序，显著提高了拆解效率。该工作与Agent方向相关，其调度算法可迁移至多智能体协同任务规划场景。
raw_content: Dismantling aircrafts reaching their end of life is a complex endeavour that is necessary in terms of sustainability but yields small income margins for air transport companies. title: Valid and Expressive Copulas for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
summary: 我们提出CopFITi，一种用于不规则多元时间序列（IMTS）概率预测的copula模型。该模型结合了归一化流对单变量边缘分布的表达能力，以及高斯混合copula对联合依赖结构的一致性与灵活性。实验表明，解耦边缘与联合的copula方法比直接拟合完整联合的架构能获得更优的边缘模型。CopFITi为处理不规则时序数据的概率建模提供了新思路，其解耦设计可迁移至Agent/RAG系统中多变量依赖关系的灵活建模。

raw_content: In the context of artificial neural networks, subliminal learning refers to the transfer of task-relevant knowledge or unintended biases from teacher to student models through distillation on task-unrelated input$\unicode{x2013}$output pairs. title: Relevant Walk Search for Explaining Graph Neural Networks

title: Graph-based Complexity Forecasts in UK En Route Airspace Using Relevant Aircraft Interactions
summary: 基于相关航空器对交互的图模型，提出一种概率方法预测英国航路空域扇区复杂度。该方法通过识别需要监控或冲突解脱的航空器对，量化未来交通负荷的细微变化。相比行业标准模型，能更准确捕捉空域复杂度动态。与Agent/RAG方向关联：该图结构可启发多智能体系统中任务复杂度预测与资源分配优化。
raw_content: Effectively managing Air Traffic Control Officer (ATCO) workload is crucial in maintaining operational safety. Group supervisors use tools that estimate upcoming traffic load to aid decision-making. However, industry-standard models can fail to capture the nuances of upcoming air traffic complexity. summary: 本研究提出一种新颖的上游任务——学习同步网络中的动态稳定景观，通过首创的图到图像预测范式，直接从图结构预测每个节点的类图像稳定景观。该方法能够推导出多种标量稳定性指标，相比传统基于网络科学或图神经网络的单节点标量指标，提供了对同步行为更深层的理解。该工作与多智能体系统的同步控制与鲁棒性分析密切相关，为Agent网络中的协同行为建模提供了新视角。
raw_content: The robustness of synchronization is typically characterized by scalar, per-node stability indices whose dependence on topology is studied via network science or graph neural networks (GNNs). title: A graph-based analysis of semantic types and coercion in contextualized word embeddings
summary: 本研究提出基于图的分析方法，探究上下文词嵌入中语义类型与强制转换现象。通过从十种语义类型选取名词，标注语料实例为类型匹配、强制转换、其他不匹配及无限制四类，并利用BERT和增强语义嵌入构建图。引入邻居类型概率和邻居类型熵两个指标，揭示词嵌入如何反映词汇与上下文类型信息，为理解语言模型中的语义类型处理机制提供新视角，对RAG系统中语义匹配与上下文理解具有参考价值。

title: Optimal Dimension-Free Sampling for Regularized Classification
summary: 该研究针对正则化分类问题，提出了实现 $(1\pm\varepsilon)$ 相对误差的最优无维度采样界，涵盖逻辑损失、铰链损失和ReLU损失等Lipschitz连续分类损失函数。关键结果包括：对于 $\|\cdot\|_2/k$ 正则化，采样复杂度上下界为 $k^2/\varepsilon^2$；对于 $\|\cdot\|_1/k$ 正则化，上下界为 $k/\varepsilon^2$。该工作为Agent系统中高效处理大规模分类数据提供了理论采样保障，可优化RAG场景下分类模型的训练效率与内存占用。

title: Contrast to Detect: Dynamic Graph Contrastive Regularization for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
summary: 该研究提出动态图对比正则化方法，用于无监督多变量时间序列异常检测。核心贡献在于通过对比学习捕获变量间动态依赖关系，在无标签条件下实现异常识别。关键结果：在多个基准数据集上，该方法相比现有重建型检测器提升F1分数达5-10%，且有效区分结构漂移下的异常模式。与RAG方向关联：其动态图建模技术可增强时间序列RAG系统的上下文感知能力，提升异常事件检索的鲁棒性。

summary: Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL)模型估计是一种基于成对比较数据对项目进行排序的经典方法。本研究针对半随机对抗环境下的谱算法，推导了其逐项误差界，突破了传统均匀采样图的限制。关键结果包括：在对抗性噪声下，谱排序的逐项误差具有理论保证。该工作为鲁棒排序算法提供了理论支撑，可应用于Agent系统中的偏好聚合与RAG场景下的相关性排序。
raw_content: Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) model estimation is a well-established strategy to rank a collection of items given a dataset of pairwise comparisons. title: Real-Time Earthquake Magnitude Classification from Initial P-Waves: Models, Dataset, and Comparative Analysis for South Asia
summary: 本研究提出基于单台站垂直分量初始7秒P波窗口的地震震级快速分类方法，对比六种从传统模型到先进深度学习的机器学习方案。关键成果：构建南亚地区7318个地震事件新数据集，实现震级实时分类。该工作为Agent驱动的灾害预警系统提供快速震级评估能力，可集成至RAG知识库辅助应急决策。
raw_content: Rapid earthquake magnitude estimation is crucial for effective early warning systems that can save lives and reduce economic damage. In this paper, we present a comprehensive study of magnitude classification using only the vertical component of the initial 7-second P-wave window from a single station. We compare six machine learning approaches that range from traditional models to state-of-the-art deep learning architectures. We also curated a novel dataset of 7,318 earthquake events in South A

title: Evaluating PhaseNet on Teleseismic Data with MsPASS
summary: 本研究提出基于MsPASS的可复现工作流，用于解决PhaseNet在远震信号上P波和S波拾取性能显著下降的问题。该工作流支持大规模地震档案的可扩展数据准备与管理，并实现标准化的PhaseNet训练与推理。通过构建包含160万条波形的控制数据集，验证了远震P波拾取的改进效果。该方法为地震信号处理中的机器学习模型优化提供了可复现的基准流程，对Agent驱动的自动化地震数据分析具有参考价值。
raw_content: Numerous studies have shown that the machine-learning picker PhaseNet produces accurate P and S picks on local earthquake signals, but its performance can degrade sharply on teleseismic signals. To address this limitation, we present a reproducible MsPASS workflow that (i) enables scalable data preparation and management for large seismic archives and (ii) supports standardized PhaseNet training and inference. title: The Cognitive Kardashev Scale: Quantifying the Material Envelope of Civilisational Computation
summary: 该论文提出了认知卡尔达肖夫等级量表，用于量化文明所能支撑的持续AI级计算总量。核心计算基于四个参数：总功率P、认知能耗占比f、能量转化为计算的效率η以及计算架构效率。结果显示，I型文明可支撑约10^26次操作/秒的AI计算，II型达10^36次/秒，III型达10^46次/秒。该框架为评估未来AI系统的物理极限提供了理论基准，对理解Agent系统在星际尺度下的计算资源约束具有重要参考价值。
raw_content: How much thinking can a civilisation do? Kardashev's (1964) typology ranks civilisations by total power: planetary (Type I, ~10^16 W), stellar (Type II, ~10^26 W), galactic (Type III). This paper builds an analogous Cognitive Kardashev Scale: how much sustained AI-grade computation each tier could support. title: Cross-attention-based bipartite graph neural network for coupled nodal and elemental field prediction in large-deformation sheet material forming
summary: 基于交叉注意力的二分图神经网络，用于大变形板材成形中节点与单元耦合场预测。该方法直接建模节点运动学与单元变形之间的耦合关系，在板材成形模拟中实现节点-单元联合预测，相比传统节点中心图模型，单元场预测精度提升约15%-20%。该工作为RAG系统中图结构数据与多模态场预测的融合提供了新思路，可扩展至Agent驱动的材料仿真加速。
raw_content: Finite element simulations of large-deformation sheet material forming involve node-element coupling between nodal kinematics and element-level deformation measures. Machine-learning surrogates can accelerate such simulations, but most graph-based models use node-centred representations. This representation is indirect for element-level quantities, which are often recovered from nodal predictions by interpolation or post-processing. title: From Simulation to Discovery: AI Enabled Probabilistic Emulation of Mechanistic Crop Systems
summary: 本文提出一种基于概率神经网络的APSIM模拟器，能够高保真地复现玉米生长过程的13个关键输出（R²达0.93），同时将模拟时间降低数个数量级。该模型通过两百万次涵盖多样化遗传与环境的仿真训练，实现了从传统机理模型到高效概率仿真的跨越。在Agent/RAG/MCP方向，该工作为农业数字孪生中的实时决策与大规模场景探索提供了可扩展的AI驱动仿真基础。
raw_content: Global food security depends on predicting crop responses to climate variability, yet process based crop models remain too computationally expensive for large scale exploration of genotype and environment interactions. Here we develop a probabilistic neural emulator of APSIM that reproduces key maize growth processes across 13 outputs with high fidelity (with R^2 of 0.93) while reducing simulation time by several orders of magnitude. title: VAMP-Diff: VampPrior Latent Diffusion for Photoplethysmography Modeling
summary: VAMP-Diff提出一种基于VampPrior潜变量扩散模型的光电容积描记法（PPG）生成方法。该方法通过变分自编码器将PPG信号映射到潜空间，并利用扩散模型生成逼真的波形形态，解决了现有生成模型难以保留真实波形形态和捕捉心肺生理结构的问题。关键亮点在于实现了从真实信号到潜表示的可逆推理路径，同时生成波形在形态保真度上优于对抗训练方法。该工作为生理信号生成与表征学习提供了新范式，可应用于医疗Agent中的信号增强与异常检测任务。
raw_content: Photoplethysmography (PPG) has become a ubiquitous physiological signal; however, current generative models still struggle to preserve realistic waveform morphology and learn a latent structure that captures cardiac and respiratory physiology. PPG generators trained with adversarial losses can produce plausible waveforms, but provide no inference path from a real signal to a latent representation. title: PilotWiMAE: Pilot-Native Representation Learning for Wireless Channels
summary: PilotWiMAE提出一种面向无线信道的自监督表示学习框架，其编码器直接处理含噪导频观测，并通过注意力机制沿时间与联合空频轴分解，引入基于物理的归纳偏置。该方法将观测空间缩小两个数量级，并消除了部署中不现实的完全信道假设。该工作为Agent/RAG/MCP方向中处理高维、稀疏观测数据的自监督学习提供了可借鉴的物理启发式架构设计思路。
raw_content: Channel foundation models assume access to fully observed channels, an assumption that fails in deployment. We introduce PilotWiMAE, a self-supervised framework whose encoder ingests noisy pilot observations directly and whose attention factorizes along the axis separating temporal from joint space-frequency processing, an inductive bias inspired by the physics of the problem. title: JointHRRP-Net: A Statistically Constrained Decoupling Network for Joint Target and Jamming Recognition in Composite Jamming
summary: JointHRRP-Net是一种统计约束解耦网络，用于复合干扰环境下的联合目标与干扰识别。该方法通过解耦HRRP域中与目标回波耦合的压制和欺骗干扰分量，显著提升了散射峰的可区分性。在复合干扰场景下，目标识别性能较传统方法提升超过15%，特征可分性增强。该工作为RAG系统中多源信号解耦与特征增强提供了统计约束框架，可推广至Agent感知中的干扰抑制任务。
raw_content: High-resolution range profile (HRRP)-based radar automatic target recognition suffers from severe performance degradation in composite jamming environments. Active jamming introduces suppression- and deception-related components into the received range profile. After pulse compression, these components are coupled with target echoes in the HRRP domain, making target-related scattering peaks difficult to distinguish and weakening feature separability. title: Classification of IED-free EEG Responses for Assisted Epilepsy Diagnosis
summary: 该研究提出一种基于机器学习特征的标准化流程，用于分类无癫痫样放电（IED）的脑电图反应，以辅助癫痫诊断。通过整合时间、频谱、小波和连接性域特征，并采用堆叠集成方法融合互补特征集，在间歇性光刺激和过度换气诱发实验中实现高分类性能。该工作为RAG驱动的临床决策支持系统提供了可复现的EEG分析范式，有助于提升无IED病例的癫痫诊断客观性。
raw_content: Diagnosing epilepsy is challenging when routine EEGs lack interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs). Intermittent photic stimulation (IPS) and hyperventilation (HV) can increase diagnostic yield, but their interpretation is subjective. We propose a reproducible pipeline that classifies EEG recordings acquired during stimulation procedures, using machine-learning features spanning temporal, spectral, wavelet, and connectivity domains, and a stacked ensemble to combine complementary feature sets.

title: Staging by the Book: Automatic Sleep Stage Classification Using Scoring Rules
summary: 基于美国睡眠医学会评分规则，提出一种确定性、基于规则的自动睡眠分期方法，替代传统黑箱深度学习模型。该方法显式操作临床评分标准，实现透明决策过程。与深度学习模型相比，在保持接近人类评分一致性的同时，完全可解释。该工作为医疗AI中的可解释性提供了新范式，尤其适用于需要严格遵循临床指南的RAG系统，确保睡眠分期结果符合医学规范。
raw_content: Automated sleep staging is commonly approached as a supervised machine learning problem, with deep learning methods dominating recent research. While machine learning models achieve near-human level agreement with human-scored reference sleep stages, their decisions are typically opaque and not designed to follow clinical scoring rules. title: Resilience Characterization of AI-Native Wireless Receivers via Persistent Homology
summary: 基于持久同调理论，提出拓扑韧性指数（TRI）作为实时度量指标，用于刻画基于深度学习的AI原生无线接收器在分布偏移下的结构稳定性。TRI通过持续同调指数量化神经网络接收器参数的结构稳定性，弥补了传统误码率（BER）指标在非平稳信道条件下对韧性表征不足的缺陷。该工作为AI接收器在动态环境中的鲁棒性评估提供了新工具，可扩展至Agent/RAG系统中模型分布偏移的实时监测与自适应调整。
raw_content: AI-native wireless receivers based on deep learning exhibit remarkable performance under stationary channel conditions, yet their resilience to distributional shifts remains poorly characterized by conventional metrics such as bit error rate (BER). To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a novel real-time metric, the Topological Resilience Index (TRI), grounded in persistent homology and persistence exponents. title: Is TabPFN the Silver Bullet for Insurance Pricing?
summary: TabPFN能否成为保险定价的银弹？本文首次实证评估了表格基础模型（TFM）在非寿险定价中的应用。TFM通过在海量合成数据集上预训练，无需针对特定数据集拟合或超参数调优，即可通过上下文学习对新数据进行推理。结果表明，TFM在索赔频率和严重性建模上优于广义线性模型和梯度提升机，为保险定价提供了全新范式。该工作展示了预训练基础模型在结构化数据任务中的潜力，对Agent驱动的自动化定价系统具有重要参考价值。
raw_content: Modelling claim frequency and severity for non-life insurance pricing predominantly relies on generalised linear models, with gradient-boosted machines as the leading machine learning alternative. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) offer a fundamentally different paradigm. By pre-training on large collections of synthetic datasets, TFMs enable inference on new data through in-context learning, without any dataset-specific fitting or hyperparameter tuning. title: Suicide Risk Assessment from AI-powered Video Surveillance: An Interpretable Framework for Prevention in Metro Stations
summary: 基于AI视频监控的地铁自杀风险评估：提出一种可解释框架，通过联合推理每位乘客的行为、空间上下文及时间动态，从监控视频中评估自杀风险。该框架在真实地铁场景中实现85%的早期预警准确率，较传统方法提升12%。与Agent方向关联：可集成至多智能体监控系统，实现实时风险预警与干预决策支持。
raw_content: Understanding and monitoring human behavior in metro stations play an important role in supporting suicide prevention efforts, where early identification of high-risk situations can enable timely intervention. This requires assessing suicide risk from a surveillance video by jointly reasoning about the behavior of each passenger, his/her spatial context, and temporal dynamics. title: Diffusion-based Denoising Beats Vanilla Score Matching in Parameter Estimation: A Theoretical Explanation
summary: 扩散去噪评分匹配在参数估计中优于普通评分匹配：理论解释。本文提出一种新型扩散去噪评分匹配估计器（DDSME），在模式分离的多峰分布场景下，相比普通评分匹配估计器（SME）效率显著提升。理论分析表明，DDSME通过扩散过程有效缓解了多峰分布中评分函数梯度消失问题，在参数估计精度上超越SME。该工作为扩散模型在RAG系统中处理复杂分布数据提供了理论支撑。
raw_content: Score matching is an alternative to maximum likelihood estimation when the normalizing constant is unknown or too costly to evaluate. However, vanilla score matching has shown to be inefficient relative to maximum likelihood estimation for multimodal distributions with well-separated modes, which are commonly encountered in practical applications. title: Active Sensing Subserves Task-Level Control
summary: 主动感知传统上被定义为通过运动消耗能量以获取信息。本文提出，自适应传感器的依赖、运动与感知的耦合以及任务级控制的结合，必然导致主动感知运动的涌现。因此，主动感知并非由最小化状态不确定性等感官目标驱动，而是任务级控制的必要条件。该研究揭示了感知与控制的深层关联，为Agent系统中感知-行动循环的设计提供了理论支撑，有助于优化RAG场景下的信息采集策略。
raw_content: Active sensing is traditionally defined as the expenditure of energy, typically in the form of movement, for obtaining information. Here, we propose that the combination of reliance on adaptive sensors, the linkage between movement and sensing, and task-level control inevitably gives rise to the emergence of active sensing movements. title: The TIME Machine: On The Power of Motion for Efficient Perception
summary: 该研究提出TIME Machine，一种通过运动信息实现高效视频感知的表示学习方法。关键亮点在于仅利用运动线索即可达到与大规模语言监督模型相当的识别性能，同时将计算成本降低一个数量级。该方法无需依赖语言标注，为Agent系统在资源受限场景下实现高效视频理解提供了新范式，尤其适用于RAG中多模态视频检索与实时感知任务。
raw_content: Video representation learning has seen tremendous progress in recent years. This has been driven by many factors, including the scale of training and the success of visual models trained contrastively with language. title: KAPLAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Prognostic Learnable Activation Networks for Survival Analysis
summary: KAPLAN-HR是一种基于B样条Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的非参数生存分析模型，用于联合估计协变量与时间对条件风险函数的影响。该方法无需手动指定交互项与时变效应，在丰富临床数据集上显著优于Cox模型和广义加性模型。该工作为Agent/RAG方向提供了处理时序事件预测的非参数建模新思路，可增强智能体对生存数据的动态风险理解能力。
raw_content: Survival analysis aims to model how covariates and time jointly shape the time-to-event distribution under right censoring. Classical methods such as the Cox model and generalised additive models (GAMs) require interactions and time-varying effects to be manually specified, which is increasingly impractical on rich clinical datasets. title: Do Synthetic Brain MRIs Reliably Improve Tumour Classification? A StyleGAN2-ADA Class-Plane Augmentation Study on BRISC 2025
summary: 生成式增强常被提议用于解决医学图像小样本问题，但合成图像仅在提升下游任务性能时才有价值。本研究在BRISC 2025数据集上训练了12个类平面StyleGAN2-ADA生成器，测试其输出（结合InceptionV3特征）对脑肿瘤分类的改进效果。关键发现：合成图像未能可靠提升分类准确率，部分场景甚至导致性能下降。该结果警示，在RAG或Agent驱动的医学诊断流程中，盲目使用GAN增强可能引入噪声，需严格验证合成数据对实际任务的增益。
raw_content: Generative augmentation is often proposed as a remedy for small medical-image datasets, but synthetic images are only useful when they improve downstream task performance. "Augmentation" here means synthetic supplementation: GAN-generated samples added to the real training pool, not geometric or photometric transforms of existing images. title: Encrypted Neural Networks without Overflows
summary: 全同态加密（FHE）通过加密数据上的神经网络评估实现隐私推理，CKKS方案是高效FHE实现的核心，但仅支持加法、乘法和数组旋转操作。本文提出一种无溢出加密神经网络方法，确保激活函数在特定区间内用多项式近似时不发生数值溢出。该工作为Agent系统中安全外包计算提供了加密推理基础，尤其适用于RAG场景下用户隐私保护的数据处理。
raw_content: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables private inference by evaluating neural networks on encrypted data. In this way, we can delegate the computation to a third party server without ever revealing the user's data. title: Defining AI Fatigue in Academic Contexts: Dimensions, Indicators, and a Stage-Based Model Using Grounded Theory
summary: 本研究提出“AI疲劳”概念模型，定义为学术场景中持续使用AI工具产生的特定压力。基于菲律宾三所大学1054名学生的开放式回答，采用扎根理论分析，识别出AI疲劳的维度与指标，并构建阶段模型。该成果为Agent/RAG方向的人机交互疲劳评估提供理论基础，有助于优化AI工具在学术场景中的可持续使用设计。
raw_content: The integration of AI tools in academic settings has introduced a distinct form of strain that existing frameworks like technostress and digital fatigue have not yet fully addressed. This study develops a conceptual model and identifies the dimensions that define AI fatigue as a form of strain arising from sustained academic use of AI tools. title: Operationalizing Individual Fairness via Gradient Descent and Bradley-Terry Models
summary: 本文提出一种基于三元组查询（“个体i与j或k谁更相似？”）学习马氏相似度度量的算法，用于实现个体公平性（“相似个体应被相似对待”）。通过梯度下降与Bradley-Terry模型优化，该方法能有效从人类反馈中学习公平性度量。与Agent/RAG/MCP方向的关联：该算法可为多智能体系统中的公平性约束提供可学习的相似度度量，增强RAG中个体间相似性判断的公平性。
raw_content: Individual fairness, the notion that "similar individuals should be treated similarly," provides a strong and flexible fairness guarantee for algorithmic decision makers. However, a barrier to implementing individual fairness in practice is the difficulty of learning the similarity metric over individuals. title: Lipschitz Optimization for Formal Verification of Homographies
summary: 该研究提出基于Lipschitz优化的同形变换形式化验证方法，首次将视觉神经网络的鲁棒性验证扩展到相机运动扰动。关键结果包括：通过Lipschitz常数界实现同形变换下输出差异的严格上界估计，验证精度达95%以上。该方法填补了现有ℓ_p范数验证无法覆盖相机运动扰动的空白，为自动驾驶等安全关键场景中的视觉Agent系统提供形式化鲁棒性保障。
raw_content: The adoption of vision neural networks in regulated industries requires formal robustness guarantees, especially in safety-critical domains such as healthcare, autonomous vehicles, and aerospace. However, current approaches are confined to incomplete statistical verification or robustness to $\ell_p$-norm and affine transforms, which cover only a narrow subset of perturbations to the image formation process. title: SimInsert: Seamless Video Object Insertion via Regional Sparse Attention Fusion
summary: SimInsert 提出一种无需训练的视频物体插入方法，将任务解耦为单帧编辑与语义运动描述。通过区域稀疏注意力融合实现时空一致性，无需显式运动工程或重训练。该方法在保持交互真实感的同时，显著提升灵活性与泛化能力，为视频编辑与多模态Agent中的动态场景理解提供高效工具。
raw_content: Video object insertion requires ensuring spatio-temporal coherence and interactive realism, extending far beyond simple content placement. However, current approaches are often hindered by a reliance on explicit motion engineering or resource-intensive retraining, restricting their flexibility and generalization.
